Evanston Rides! Family Ride (Evanston Kidical Mass)

Evanston, IL · Social

FamilyNo-drop

Evanston Rides! Family Ride (Evanston Kidical Mass) is a social group ride in Evanston, IL. It rolls last Saturday of the month at 1:30 pm from Varies by ride; Oct 24 starts at Twiggs Park. About 1.5 miles, slow, family pace. No-drop.

Next ride Sat, Oct 31, 1:30 PM CDT

For visitors

Free, but register for the date you plan to ride. Helmets required. Each month's start park changes, so read the listing for the date. Chicago Family Biking's events page shows Sep 26 starting at Independence Park and Oct 24 at Twiggs Park.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 1:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: slow, family pace. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Evanston Rides! Family Ride (Evanston Kidical Mass) group ride

Evanston's monthly family ride, led by Evanston Kidical Mass volunteers. The last one of 2026, Oct 24, is a short roll to downtown for the trick-or-treat stroll.
